name: ai-features
title: AI features in the product
summary: Design LLM-powered product features that are useful, safe and affordable: when to use a model, prompts and context, retrieval, agents and tools, evaluations, guardrails, cost and latency, streaming UX and data handling.
useWhen: Add an AI assistant, chat or summarization feature to the product
Should this feature use RAG, a tool call, a bigger prompt or fine-tuning?
Build retrieval over our docs or our customers' data
Build an agent that takes actions for the user
The AI feature gives wrong answers and I cannot tell if my change helped
Protect the AI feature against prompt injection and data leaks
LLM costs are eating our margin, or responses are too slow
Design the chat or streaming interface for AI output
What customer data are we allowed to send to the model provider?

notFor.topic: Anthropic API parameters, model IDs, tool-use syntax, caching and SDK code
Using coding agents to build the product itself
EU AI Act classification and legal transparency duties
Exposing your own API to outside agents through MCP
